title: PSKReporter Heard-Station Diversity by Hour
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pskreporter:spot
| bin _time span=1h
| stats dc(dx_call) as heard_calls, dc(grid) as heard_grids by _time band
| sort - _time
description: Tracks heard-station diversity over time and breaks it out by band.
value: Unique-station counts are often a better propagation indicator than raw spot volume.
implementation: Send heard-station diversity events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1h granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of heard-station diversity by band.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how heard-station diversity changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
